title: BVR Sim: An Open and High-Throughput Environment for Heterogeneous Air-Combat Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.25419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Beyond-visual-range (BVR) air combat is a challenging reinforcement-learning domain characterized by partial observability, long-horizon decision making, energy management, and limited weapons. We present BVR Sim, an open-source Gymnasium-style environment designed for heterogeneous air-combat reinforcement learning. BVR Sim supports multiple JSBSim aircraft models, including the F-15, F-16, F/A-18, and F-22, with configurable weapons, sensors, controllers, and opponents. A unified tactical action interface specifies desired heading, altitude, speed, and weapon release above aircraft-specific inner-loop controllers, enabling policies to operate across heterogeneous platforms. The environment provides interchangeable Python and accelerated C++ backends, entity-oriented observations, compositional rewards, scripted opponents, replay and visualization, and adapters for multi-agent learning frameworks. translated_title: BVR Sim：一个面向异构空战强化学习的开放高吞吐环境
translated_abstract: 超视距（BVR）空战是一个具有挑战性的强化学习领域，其特点是部分可观测性、长时程决策、能量管理和有限武器。我们提出了BVR Sim，一个开源的Gymnasium风格环境，专为异构空战强化学习设计。BVR Sim支持多种JSBSim飞机模型，包括F-15、F-16、F/A-18和F-22，并具有可配置的武器、传感器、控制器和对手。一个统一的战术动作接口指定了期望的航向、高度、速度和武器释放，位于飞机特定的内环控制器之上，使策略能够在异构平台上运行。该环境提供了可互换的Python和加速C++后端、面向实体的观测、组合奖励、脚本化对手、回放和可视化，以及用于多智能体学习框架的适配器。在0.4秒的决策间隔下，C++后端实现了高吞吐量。
tldr: 本文提出了BVR Sim，一个开源高吞吐的空战强化学习环境，支持多种异构飞机模型和统一战术接口，旨在解决部分可观测和长时程决策挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BVR Sim, an open-source high-throughput environment for air-combat reinforcement learning, supporting heterogeneous aircraft models and a unified tactical interface to address partial observability and long-horizon decision-making challenges.
